ov: 12 قردًا (الإنجليزية: 12 Monkeys) معروف أيضًا باسم اثنا عشر قردًا (الإنجليزية: Twelve Monkeys) هو فيلم خيال علمي تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 1995. من بطولة بروس ويليس ومادلين ستو وبراد بيت وكريستوفر بلامر وديفيد مورس. وهو مستوحى من فيلم الخيال العلمي الفرنسي القصير الرصيف الذي كتبه وأخرجه كريس ماركر سنة 1962.
plotEn:
In 2035, James Cole is imprisoned beneath the ruins of Philadelphia after a virus kills 99% of humanity, forcing the survivors underground. In exchange for a pardon, Cole is selected by scientists to travel approximately 39 years into the past to investigate the virus, believed to have been released by a group known as "the Army of the Twelve Monkeys", in the hope of developing a cure. Cole also experiences recurring dreams of a man being shot at an airport terminal.
Instead of arriving in late 1996 as planned, Cole is sent to Baltimore in April 1990, where he is committed to a psychiatric hospital under the care of Dr. Kathryn Railly. There, he encounters fellow patient Jeffrey Goines, an erratic critic of consumerism. Cole attempts to convince the hospital doctors of his mission and contact the scientists using a telephone number they provided, but both efforts fail. Following an unsuccessful escape attempt with Jeffrey's assistance, Cole is abruptly returned to the future. A second attempt to reach 1996 briefly sends him to a World War I battlefield, where he encounters fellow prisoner José and is shot in the leg.
In 1996, Railly gives a public lecture on the Cassandra complex and encounters Dr. Peters, who expresses concern about humanity's environmental impact. After the event, Railly is kidnapped by Cole, who forces her to drive him to Philadelphia. Railly reluctantly accompanies Cole and removes the bullet from his leg.
